result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six listings and lookups you named. The full suite passes (614 tests). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added a `description` component, null when the promotion has none.
- **`resources/schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and the seven promotion queries (create, lookup by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period) select it and map it back.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: `createPromotion` has a new 6-argument overload taking the description as its last parameter. The existing 5-argument form delegates with no description, so current callers are untouched. A null or blank description is stored as null.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new test `keepsDescriptionInListingsAndLookups` checks the text through each listing and lookup, and that a blank description comes back as null.

I did not add a description to any of the demo promotions in `DemoScenario`.
